newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO HANG ON FOR VALUABLE WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO HANG ON FOR VALUABLE WIN.

text.p: Atletico Madrid maintained their slim hopes of taking Spain's second European Cup place by hanging on for a 2-1 home victory over Sporting Gijon on Monday.
The title-holders stayed fifth with a game in hand, five points behind Deportivo Coruna and eight behind Barcelona and Real Betis.
Atletico dominated the first half and went ahead with goals from Spanish internationals Jose Luis Caminero and Kiko Narvaez before David Cano struck back as Sporting took control after the break.
